nina (AE): Quick sync 13: SkylineBank wants a Q4 commit. Traffic expectation: 500 rps peak, ~16k tokens/session, 75-90m sustained market window. Asking for reserved GPU rec + burst credits and an ops/runbook sample.

dev (Sales Eng): 500 rps + 16k tokens is big. Are they ok with quantized models? That helps capacity.

sara (Solutions): If quantized, expect ~2.3x GPU efficiency; plan for KV-cache persistence and prewarm 30-60m before window.

leo (SRE): Quick conservative rec: baseline 5 GPUs (quantized) with 2 burst slots; autoscale cap 7. Short autoscale sketch:
```
autoscale:
  baseline: 5
  max_burst: 2
  burst_window_min: 15
  kv_persist: true
```
This controls costs and keeps predictable p50.

maya (Infra): Note: Private VPC requested -> AZ spread required for their SLA. That reduces burst ability into shared pool; lead time ~3 weeks.

nina (AE): Procurement wants monthly cost + worst-case overage. Can we give a placeholder?

dev (Sales Eng): Use quantized baseline hours * $/gpu-hr + burst credit bucket (e.g., 120k tokens/month). Provide fp16 vs quantized columns.

sara (Solutions): Action items: (1) leo to run perf bench on their model tomorrow if they send container; (2) maya to enumerate Private deploy lead times and KMS checklist; (3) dev to draft CFO-facing price summary using conservative perf numbers.

sec-bot: Security checklist: outstanding - KMS test and SOC2 attestation.

leo (SRE): I'll run bench tomorrow AM. If they can't provide container, we recommend reserve 6 GPUs as safety.

nina (AE): Thanks team 44D I'll update the customer and ask for container + sample prompts. Close until perf results.
